lines.text: Excuse me. Where's the teachers' office?
lines.cn: 请问教师办公室在哪里？

lines.text: Hi. Is this the teachers' office?
lines.cn: 请问这是教师办公室吗？

lines.text: No, it isn't. The teachers' office is next to the library.
lines.cn: 不是。教师办公室在图书馆旁边。

lines.text: Welcome to our school! This is my classroom.
lines.cn: 欢迎来我们学校！这是我的教室。

lines.text: It's so big! How many students are there in your class?
lines.cn: 真大啊！你们班有多少学生？

lines.text: Yes, we do. It's on the second floor.

storybook.title: Zoom's New School
storybook.titleCn: 小熊 Zoom 的新学校

pages.en: Zoom is a little bear. Today is his first day at the new school.
pages.cn: 小熊 Zoom 第一天到新学校。

pages.en: Welcome to our school! It's so big!
pages.hint: 看到了学过的 school 吗？

pages.en: Zoom asks, "Where's the library? I love books!"
pages.cn: Zoom 问："图书馆在哪里？我喜欢书！"

pages.en: A rabbit says, "It's on the second floor. Next to the art room."
pages.cn: 小兔说："在二楼，紧挨着美术教室。"
pages.hint: second floor 和 next to 都学过了！

pages.en: Zoom goes upstairs. "Wow! Is this the art room?"
pages.cn: Zoom 上楼。"哇！这是美术教室吗？"
pages.hint: Is this...? 是另一个核心句型

pages.en: A cat answers, "No, it isn't. It's the computer room. The art room is next to it."
pages.cn: 小猫回答："不，这是计算机房。美术教室在旁边。"
pages.hint: 注意 No, it isn't 的用法

pages.en: Zoom hears music. "Do you have a music room?" he asks.
pages.cn: Zoom 听到音乐。"你们有音乐教室吗？"他问。
pages.hint: Do you have...? 询问拥有

pages.en: "Yes, we do! It's on the first floor."
pages.hint: first floor 和 Yes, we do 都是重点

pages.en: After class, all the animals play on the playground.
pages.cn: 下课后，所有小动物在操场上玩。

pages.en: Zoom loves his new school. "This is the best school ever!"
pages.cn: Zoom 喜欢他的新学校。"这是最棒的学校！"
pages.hint: 故事结束，Zoom 找到了所有教室！
